many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np
def f(x):
    x=np.array(x); out=x.copy(); h,w=x.shape
    # find large solid block and markers
    vals,cnts=np.unique(x,return_counts=True); bg=vals[np.argmax(cnts)]
    mask=x!=bg
    comp=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if mask[i,j]]
    # largest connected component (the block), others markers
    def comps(cells):
        cs=[]; seen=set(); import collections
        for c in cells:
            if c in seen: continue
            stack=[c]; cc=[c]
            while stack:
                i,j=stack.pop()
                for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    n=(i+di,j+dj)
                    if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and mask[n] and n not in seen:
                        seen.add(n); stack.append(n); cc.append(n)
            seen|=set(cc); cs.append(cc)
        return cs
    cs=comps(comp)
    blk=max(cs,key=len)
    bset={(i,j) for i,j in blk}
    # marker values distinct from block
    mk={x[i,j] for i,j in comp if x[i,j]!=x[blk[0],blk[1]]}

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter
def f(x):
    x=np.array(x); h,w=x.shape
    vals,cnts=np.unique(x,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[np.argmax(cnts)])
    mk=[(i,j,int(x[i,j])) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if x[i,j]!=bg]
    c=Counter(v for _,_,v in mk); bval=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    blk={(m[0],m[1]) for m in mk if m[2]==bval}
    out=x.copy()
    for i,j,v in mk:
        if (i,j) in blk: continue
        # find block cells sharing row or column
        tgt=[b for b in blk if b[0]==i or b[1]==j]
        if tgt:
            ni,nj=min(tgt,key=lambda b:(abs(b[0]-i)+abs(b[1]-j)))
            out[ni,nj]=v
    return out.tolist()
d=f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(d==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
t=json.dumps(f(G['Test input']))
